title: allosorus gracilis
intro: Allosorus gracilis, commonly known as the Ostrich Fern or Adder's Tongue Fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the fern family, Ostrich Fern. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Allosorus gracilis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
